summary: Primech Holdings Ltd, a Singapore-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held October 14, 2026. On the August 20, 2026 record date, 38,417,987 ordinary shares (one vote each) and 3,000,000 Class B Preference Shares (ten votes each) were outstanding. All eleven proposals passed, covering adoption of audited FY2026 financial statements and Form 20-F, re-election of two rotating directors, US$155,000 director fees, appointment of two auditors, issuance authority including the 2025 Employee Incentive Plan, and a share-consolidation authorization of up to 200-to-1. This is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation event; watch only for the board's future determination of any consolidation ratio.
